gaps.explanation: Nothing printed is missing. Exhibit E (p4, GAAP) Total Revenues 12,735,167 = General 7,624,388 + Street 2,226,960 + Capital Projects 3,055 + Debt Service 2,215,062 + Other Governmental 665,702. detail: General Fund schedule (p10) 7,624,388, nonmajor Exhibit O (p9) 665,702, Capital Projects Interest 3,055 (p4 column, added in pass 1); the Street and Debt Service Funds' only schedule is Exhibit L (p8, budgetary basis), whose resources lines are in detail. Street: Exhibit L 1,034,561 + 73,548 + 167,871 + 727,912 + 240,003 = 2,243,895 vs Exhibit E 2,226,960 (schedule 16,935 above). Debt Service: Exhibit L 1,138,419 + 15,236 + 351,920 + 50,053 = 1,555,628 vs Exhibit E 2,215,062 (schedule 659,434 short; Exhibit L shows a further 'Other Financing Sources' 925,791, in detail as other financing). 659,434 - 16,935 = 642,499 = the gap. Adding the Exhibit E Street / Debt Service column rows would count those funds twice (once budgetary, once GAAP); budgetary vs GAAP presentation of the same funds.

Nothing printed is missing. Exhibit E (p4) Total Expenditures 14,444,698 = General 7,642,913 + Street 1,067,340 + Capital Projects 2,716,630 + Debt Service 2,488,117 + Other Governmental 529,698. General (Exhibits Q-T pp11-14), Other Governmental (Exhibit O p9) and Capital Projects (p4 column, pass 1) tie. Street: Exhibit L (p8) Streets 999,976 + Capital Outlay 63,194 = 1,063,170 vs Exhibit E 1,067,340 (4,170 short). Debt Service: Exhibit L prints Capital Outlay 128,664 as its only expenditure line and the rest of its spending as 'Other Financing Uses' 2,353,225 (in detail as other financing, label as printed), vs Exhibit E General Government 40,397 + Capital Outlay 128,664 + Lease Payments 10,737 + Bond Payments 2,308,319 = 2,488,117 (2,359,453 short; 40,397 + 10,737 + 2,308,319 = 2,359,453 vs Exhibit L 2,353,225, also a basis difference). 4,170 + 2,359,453 = 2,363,623 = the gap. The Debt Service spending money is inside the Exhibit L 'Other Financing Uses' detail line, so adding the Exhibit E rows would count it twice.

Exhibit E (p4) Transfers In 1,870,308 = Capital Projects 1,600,931 (in detail, pass 1) + Debt Service 269,377. The Debt Service Fund's schedule (Exhibit L p8, budgetary) prints no transfer row: its financing inflows are the single line 'Other Financing Sources' 925,791 (already in detail), which holds the transfer money (Exhibit E Debt Service other financing: Transfers In 269,377 + Loan Proceeds 128,664 = 398,041; budgetary 925,791). Adding the 269,377 would count money already inside that line; the printed line cannot be split. Gap 269,377 stays as budgetary vs GAAP presentation.

Exhibit E (p4) Transfers Out (1,870,308) = General (250,327) + Street (1,619,981). General Fund transfers out are in detail (pp11-14: 5,000 + 3,500 + 45,000 + 40,000 + 7,000 + 3,000 + 33,000 + 4,000 + 103,828 + 6,000 = 250,328; 1 rounding). Street's Transfers Out is in detail with the same amount under the label Exhibit L (p8) prints for it, 'Other Financing Uses' -1,619,981; the label is kept as printed (never relabelled), so the transfers total does not see it. 250,328 + 1,619,981 = 1,870,309 (1 rounding). No line missing.

Exhibit E (p4) debt proceeds 1,328,664 = Capital Projects Bond Proceeds 1,200,000 (in detail) + Debt Service Loan Proceeds 128,664. The Debt Service Fund's financing inflows are in detail only as Exhibit L (p8) 'Other Financing Sources' 925,791, which holds the loan proceeds and cannot be split; adding 128,664 would count it twice. The schedule figure 1,212,223 = Bond Proceeds 1,200,000 + Insurance Proceeds 6,220 (General, p10) + 4,706 (Capital Projects, p4) + Bond Premiums 1,297 (p4), which are not debt (JSON other_financing 910,386 holds them). 1,212,223 - 12,223 + 128,664 = 1,328,664. Other Exhibit E other-financing rows: General Insurance Proceeds 6,220, Retirement Forfeiture 102,835, Sale of Property 815,307, Capital Contributions (21,507) and the Capital Projects rows are in detail. Street Insurance Proceeds 1,528 (p4) is not added: the Street Fund's detail is the Exhibit L budgetary schedule (p8), which has no such row and whose 'Local Receipts Local' 240,003 may hold it; adding the GAAP row could count it twice.
